title: Why beauty giants L’Oréal, Unilever and Puig are all betting big on dermocosmetics
summary: L’Oréal, Puig, Unilever and Beiersdorf are all tapping into the growing appetite among consumers for science-backed skin care that addresses specific concerns and show results, while the rise of GLP-1s and longevity science are expected to help propel the dermocosmetics category’s growth further
